'''Perekta Mesa''' was a mesa on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] that was severely damaged during the numerous [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] that occurred during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. The [[Shattered City|settlement]] atop the mesa was destroyed when the mesa cracked open in several places, leaving gaping canyons in the mesa's peak.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Perekta Mesa appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
